title: Hecke Symmetries and Generic Quantum Schur–Weyl Duality

items.title: The candidate antipode for the type-A quantum algebra
items.statement: On the free type-A quantum algebra presentation, reverse each word and assign S(L_j)=L_j^{-1}, S(L_j^{-1})=L_j, S(E_i)=-E_iK_i^{-1}, S(F_i)=-K_iF_i; this is only a candidate on the quotient until relation preservation is proved.
items.strategy: Define the operation on the free word basis; defer quotient well-definedness to the next local lemma.

sources.title: Pavel Etingof and Mykola Semenyakin, A brief introduction to quantum groups

items.title: The type-A quantum presentation admits its displayed antipode
items.statement: The word-reversing candidate preserves every type-A quantum presentation relation, descends to U_N, and satisfies both antipode identities for its stated coproduct and counit.
items.strategy: Check invertible Cartan and weight relations, mixed commutators, distant commutators and both quantum Serre families; then verify the two antipode products on generators and extend to all words.

sources.title: Pavel Etingof and Mykola Semenyakin, A brief introduction to quantum groups

title: Hecke Symmetries and Generic Quantum Schur–Weyl Duality — Examples

items.title: The rank-two ordered-basis Hecke operator and all braid cases
items.statement: Compute the N=2 operator matrix and quadratic relation, display all thirteen weak-order triple braid cases, and distinguish q=1 from q=-1.
items.strategy: Apply the three defining pair cases to the complete ordered-pair and weak-order triple bases.

sources.title: Li Luo and Weiqiang Wang, Lectures on dualities ABC in representation theory

items.title: The quantum and Hecke operators commute in rank two
items.statement: For N=2 on V_2 tensor V_2, compute commutation of the local Hecke operator with E_1, F_1, L_1^{±1} and L_2^{±1} on every basis pair.
items.strategy: Evaluate the coproduct formulas on the four tensor basis vectors and compare the two compositions; use label-multiset preservation for the Cartan generators.

sources.title: Pavel Etingof and Mykola Semenyakin, A brief introduction to quantum groups
Li Luo and Weiqiang Wang, Lectures on dualities ABC in representation theory

items.title: The rank-one tensor action of the two-strand Hecke algebra is not faithful
items.statement: The universal assertion that the normalized type-A Hecke action is faithful for all N and n is false: for N=1,n=2 the nonzero element T_1-q acts as zero.
items.strategy: Use the two-element type-A1 standard basis and evaluate the sole Hecke generator on the repeated one-label tensor.

sources.title: Li Luo and Weiqiang Wang, Lectures on dualities ABC in representation theory
